title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Gemini Labs Site…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Gemini Labs Site Reviews (up to version 8.3.6) due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This flaw allows an attacker to inject code into web pages viewed by other users. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 5.3, indicating medium severity, with network attack vector, low attack complexity, no privileges or user interaction required, and limited confidentiality impact.
